findings.finding: Export helper maps display grade to a provenance-like label: solid -> measuredBacked, dashed -> interpolatedBacked.
findings.consequence: A measured-derived source with support in the dashed band (e.g. C_M(6;10,3)=0.40) is serialized as interpolatedBacked. Display grade is used as an ancestry type.

findings.finding: The shipped generalized-export path is a confidence/grade-gated Douglas-Peucker that pins low-confidence and grade-transition vertices, but does not aggregate complete-source typed evidence.
findings.consequence: Within a protected run, retained geometry can replace a complete source arc without recomputing typed provenance, support, applicability, or lineage.

scope: This audits the export semantics of the v0.6.5 application release. It is independent of the field-derived Table 6 audit, which uses a frozen study-local terrain module snapshot (see ../real-data-audit/README.md).
